# ethereum-optimism/infra Daily Update (Jul 31, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's focus was on maintenance and security, with numerous dependency updates and the closure of many long-standing issues related to the deprecated `op-program` and the "Standard L2 Genesis" initiative.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

No completed work was reported for this period.

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- **Dependency and Tooling Updates**: Several pull requests were opened to update dependencies and tooling. These include switching `replica-healthcheck` to `StaticJsonRpcProvider` to investigate a memory leak ([#694](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/694)), requiring Go 1.26.5 for builds ([#693](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/693)), and numerous security updates for modules like `github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum` ([#692](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/692)), `github.com/consensys/gnark-crypto` ([#691](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/691)), `click` ([#690](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/690)), `@babel/core` ([#689](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/689)), `google.golang.org/grpc` ([#688](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/688)), `github.com/klauspost/compress` ([#687](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/687)), and `github.com/go-yaml/yaml` ([#686](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/686)).

## CLOSED ISSUES

- **Deprecation of `op-program` Related Issues**: A significant number of issues related to `op-program` were closed as "not planned" due to its removal from the monorepo in favor of the Rust `kona-client`. This includes issues concerning building with custom config ([#15944](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/15944)), creating prestates for interop upgrade ([#15965](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/15965)), Go SSA callgraph analysis ([#11229](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/11229)), removing op-geth Hash Scheme Dependency ([#11551](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/11551)), TinyGo compilation ideas ([#11548](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/11548)), sanitizing for non-determinism ([#11667](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/11667)), configurable host request timeouts ([#12678](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/12678)), preventing recursive block execution ([#13663](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/13663)), bypassing consolidation due to unbounded `superRoot.Chains` length ([#15205](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/15205)), improving `transitionState` sanity checks ([#15199](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/15199)), bedrock contracts test setup failures ([#15220](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/15220)), `make reproducible-prestate` issues ([#15273](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/15273)), revising `verify-reproducibility` ([#17156](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/17156)), and updating engine API checks ([#17336](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/17336)).
- **"Standard L2 Genesis" Initiative Issues Closed**: Several issues related to the "Standard L2 Genesis" effort were closed as "not planned" or "superseded" due to changes in architecture or maintainer decisions. These include L2 Genesis Simplification ([#11558](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/11558)), creating a failure mode analysis ([#12296](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/12296)), implementing `FeeVault` modifications ([#12297](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/12297)), `OptimismPortal` modifications ([#12298](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/12298)), `CrossDomainMessenger` changes ([#12300](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/12300)), Isthmus Tracking ([#12302](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/12302)), `SuperchainConfig` Upgrader Role ([#12305](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/12305)), L1 contracts using OZ v5 Initializable ([#12655](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/12655)), preventing exceeding L2BlockGasLimit ([#12578](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/12578)), preventing start block misconfiguration ([#12579](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/12579)), Semgrep Rule for non-initializable predeploys ([#12580](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/12580)), enabling L2 Genesis file generation from previous releases ([#12708](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/12708)), renaming the `uprgrader` role ([#12861](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/12861)), adding `setFeeVaultConfig` calls to `SystemConfig.init` ([#13038](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/13038)), reviewing and addressing audit findings ([#13043](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/13043)), and establishing the ability to test the upgrade path ([#13341](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/13341)).
- **Contract and Deployment Process Improvements**: Issues related to contract management and deployment were closed. This includes removing immutable `L2_CHAIN_ID` from `FaultDisputeGame.sol` ([#11323](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/11323)), `AnchorStateRegistry` emitting on `tryUpdateAnchorState()` ([#11496](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/11496)), L2 Contracts Release ([#11778](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/11778)), Contract Versioning Tool ([#11907](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/11907)), separating `op-deployer` from `op-chain-ops` ([#11925](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/11925)), Standard L2 Genesis: L2 `ProxyAdmin` ([#12303](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/12303)), `OptimismMintableERC721Factory` Modifications ([#12304](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/12304)), `SystemConfig` Modifications ([#12299](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/12299)), `StandardBridge` Changes ([#12301](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/12301)), adding a test for OPCM gas usage ([#13021](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/13021)), a checklist for shipping contracts to prod ([#13228](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/13228)), `op-deployer` build/usage issues ([#13939](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/13939)), using tag v1.8.0 for L1 contract deployment errors ([#13966](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/13966)), revised OPCM oriented bounty and audit processes ([#14055](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/14055)), and OPCM adding permissionless game to deploy() ([#14235](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/14235)).
- **Miscellaneous Closures**: Other closed issues include a withdrawal transaction stuck on OP Sepolia ([#13466](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/13466)), adding a default label `M-needs-triage` to issues ([#13647](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/13647)), Optimism mise install error ([#17963](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/17963)), and adding safe head DB to Kona ([#18748](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/18748)).
